name: Near Site Prototype
author: Ohima_Interactive_chasep
description: WASD + Mouse to move.  Tab for settings.   So you find yourself stuck on a floating rock over a volcano, defenseless, hunted by a hover-bot you can't kill, AND you're super near sighted?  Better be sneaky and do your best to find clues on how to escape without being slain.  If only you had a pair of glasses....even then, I can only imagine how fragile they are...
